title: Albert versus Boehm system among New Orleans clarinetists
summary: He lists New Orleans clarinetists who played Albert system and recalls briefly trying a Boehm system that Al Landry tried to sell him.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals
